title: Terms of Storage: How Rent Is Billed on Grain Left in the Cooperative's Houses
content:
Storage is billed in arrears for each billing period the grain stands in store under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements. These are the terms on which that rent arises.

## Terms

**Free days.** Free days are counted in whole calendar days from the storage start date, the storage start date itself counting as day zero, and grain moving out on or before the last free day carries no storage charge at all.

**Grouping into periods.** The term that "Beyond the free days the days in store are grouped into billing periods of the programme's period length, any part of a period counting as a whole one, and each period is billed on the bushels standing in store through that period" is no longer in force, and a billing period is now fixed on the current basis rather than by grouping the days in store.

**Which rate is used.** Which rate is used is fixed by the programme's billing basis and is never a choice made at the counter: a daily basis bills the daily rate times the days in the period, a monthly basis bills the monthly rate once for the period, and a flat-fee basis bills nothing period by period because the member bought storage through the paid-up date up front.

**The floor.** Where the computed charge for a period falls under the programme's period minimum the minimum is billed instead.

**Stepping up for time in store.** The term that "Once the grain has stood in store past the escalation point the rate steps up by the escalation percentage for every period after it, and the step-up is not retrospective" is no longer in force, and the step-up for time in store is now taken on the current basis.

**Paid-up agreements.** On a paid-up agreement, bushels still in store after the paid-up date begin billing at the programme's ordinary rate from the day after that date, and no part of the up-front charge is refunded for grain that leaves early.

## Free days, on both sides of the boundary

| Day the bushels move out, counted from the storage start date | Storage charge |
| --- | --- |
| the last free day or earlier | none at all |
| the day after the last free day | the period is chargeable |

The storage start date itself counts as day zero, so on a programme posting a free period of 30 days the thirtieth day after the start date is still free and the thirty-first is not. On a programme posting no free period, the day after the storage start date is already chargeable.

## The three bases, side by side

| Basis the programme bills on | What is billed for a period |
| --- | --- |
| per bushel per day | the daily rate, applied to the days in the period |
| per bushel per month | the monthly rate, once for the period |
| flat fee | nothing period by period, storage having been bought through the paid-up date |

## Paid-up grain that stays on

Bushels still standing in store after the paid-up date begin billing at the programme's ordinary rate from the day after that date. Grain that leaves before the paid-up date carries no refund of any part of what was paid up front.
